messages:
Rosa: Hi — quick one from my trip to Berlin. My corporate card charged the hotel €120 but my bank statement shows an additional FX fee of €6. Is that reimbursable? The hotel folio only shows the room rate and city tax.
Samir (Finance): Hi Rosa, FX/merchant conversion fees are reimbursable if the charge is a legitimate business expense and the cardholder had no corporate MX option at checkout. Please upload the folio + bank statement snippet showing the FX fee. We'll code it as 'Travel - Misc (FX fee)'.
Rosa: Uploading now: https://drive.redwood/receipts/1832109876-hotel-folio.pdf and https://drive.redwood/receipts/1832109876-bank-snip.png
Samir (Finance): Got them. One policy note: if a merchant posts in USD and the bank converts, sometimes CardOps can request a merchant-level refund for the conversion portion. I'll check if the hotel can re-bill in EUR.
CardOps Bot: Ticket created CO-2026-498. Checking merchant settlement currency and whether a corrected invoice can be issued. ETA 24h.
Rosa: Thanks. If hotel can't re-bill, is it better for me to submit two line-items (room €120, FX fee €6) or a single total converted to USD?
Samir (Finance): Submit two line items with receipts: one for the room (hotel folio), one for the FX fee with bank screenshot and note "bank foreign transaction fee". This preserves original currency in our records. We'll reimburse in USD at the daily rate used by Finance.
TravelOps: Heads-up — for EU hotels we usually recommend selecting the card-present terminal option to avoid dynamic currency conversion (DCC). If staff see a prompt about "Pay in USD/EUR", choose EUR to avoid extra charges. We'll add a reminder to the travel guide.
Rosa: Good tip, I think the front desk defaulted to USD on their POS. Will flag TravelOps guide.
CardOps Bot: Update CO-2026-498: merchant confirmed they charged in USD due to POS DCC. No corrected folio available. CardOps recommends reimbursement per policy.
Samir (Finance): Okay closing loop: Rosa, please file expense with two line items and attach both screenshots. Expect reimbursement in the next payroll run (or sooner if marked urgent). Mark as "urgent" if you need faster cash.
Rosa: Filed and marked urgent. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
